response.explanation: Vous souhaitez commencer à épargner pour votre retraite, et ces produits offrent différentes façons de le faire, de la gestion automatisée au conseil personnalisé. Vous pouvez comparer ces options et décider celle qui vous convient. Les frais, les conditions et l'admissibilité peuvent changer, alors confirmez les modalités importantes directement auprès de chaque fournisseur.

tools.name: Moka
tools.why: Moka is a Canadian savings and investing app that rounds up everyday purchases and invests the spare change in a managed ETF portfolio, with a monthly subscription fee. It is only available to Canadian residents, so it may not be open to someone living in the UK.

tools.name: BMO Savings Builder Account
tools.why: This is a Canadian BMO savings account that pays a bonus interest rate when you make regular monthly deposits, with no monthly fee. It is a Canadian bank product, so it is not likely to be open to someone living in the UK.

tools.name: Oaken Financial
tools.why: Oaken is a Canadian online savings provider offering savings accounts and GICs (fixed-term deposits) with no monthly fees, including registered options such as TFSA and RRSP. It is a Canadian-only service, so it may not be open to someone living in the UK.
